svt_mipi_dsi_host Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_host:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This class implements MIPI DSI Host Driver component.

Driver at transmitter end, which will get the transaction from sequencer and calculates necessary parameters like ecc and checksum and converts the transaction into byte queue. Then transmits those data on the interface.

If the Device sends the response data after the BTA, then this Driver will react as a receiver and receives packet from the Device and performs checks on it.

User can get that response packet using analysis port.

Member Function Documentation

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_host::build_phase
 (  uvm_phase phase  ) 

This is the build phase of Host driver. In this phase, gets object of svt_mipi_dsi_configuration, svt_mipi_lane_configuration and svt_event_pool. Also, gets svt_mipi_dsi_packet_exception_list and svt_mipi_lane_transaction_exception_list object for error injection.

Instantiate DSI packet transaction and lane transaction object.

Instantiate all ports.

phase - Handle of uvm_phase, which is utilized by the base class and helps in phasing.

 svt_mipi_dsi_host::dsi_packet_cov

Callback issued by driver to allow the testbench to collect functional coverage information from a transaction received from the input port.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_host::post_response_lane_transaction_get
 (  int lane_id , svt_mipi_lane_transaction xact , ref bit drop  ) 

Method called by post_response_lane_transaction_get_cb_exec callback issued by driver after pulling a transaction descriptor out of its input port, but before acting on the transaction descriptor.

lane_id - Numerical ID that identifies which input port was accessed.

xact - Reference to the transaction descriptor object of interest.

drop - A ref argument, which if sets by the user's callback implementation causes the driver to discard the transaction descriptor without further action.
